name: claude-session-manager
description: Works around the Claude Code extension losing session content on window restore: reattaches the most recent sessions to reopened windows, and opens any on-disk session (even hidden ones).

claudeSessions.autoReopen.description: On window restore, replace blank restored Claude tabs with the most recent real sessions for this workspace.

claudeSessions.autoReopenMax.description: Maximum number of sessions to reattach automatically on window restore.
